column1: # Width constraints for Russian UI strings, checked by test/ru_text_fit_test.cpp.
# Columns (tab-separated, one row per place where the string is drawn):
#   msgid      English source string, exactly as in Translations/ru.po.
#   msgctxt    Context (empty when the entry has none).
#   spacing    Letter spacing the call site passes (TextRenderOptions::spacing).
#   max_width  Pixel budget for one line of the string.
#   fit        no     = drawn as is: every line must be <= max_width.
#              yes    = drawn with UiFlags::KerningFitSpacing: the spacing that
#              wrap:N = word-wrapped by WordWrapString(text, max_width, font, spacing):
#                       at most N lines, every line <= max_width.
#   source     The call site that draws the string (file:line in Source/).
# Escaping: in msgid and msgctxt, "\t" is a tab, "\n" a newline and "\\" a backslash.
# No other escapes are used. Trailing spaces inside a field are significant.
# Format strings ({}, {:s}, {:d}) are measured with the placeholders drawn literally.
# Where the argument matters, max_width is already adjusted for it:
# both widths measured at the row's font and spacing (at spacing 0 for fit=yes rows,
# since KerningFitSpacing only needs the width at spacing 0 to fit).
# Plural entries (msgid_plural) are checked for the msgid, the msgid_plural and every
# msgstr[n]. Rows are checked for the English msgid too, as a baseline.
# Main menu: UiList item_width 510 minus the 42 px FOCUS_BIG selector on both sides; FontSize42, spacing 5.
# Shareware banner: UiArtText 640 wide, FontSize30, spacing 8.
# Settings menu title: 640 px at the minimum screen width, FontSize30, spacing 8.
# Settings list: width uiWidth-100 = 540 at 640 px, minus the 20 px FOCUS_SMALL selector on both sides = 500; FontSize24, spacing 1.
# StrCat(msg, " ", seconds left): " 10" is 36 px plus 1 spacing, so 500 - 37.
# Option categories (options.cpp): a 500 px settings list item and the 640 px settings title.
# Hero screens: UiArtText 365 wide, FontSize30, spacing 3.
# Class list: UiList 320 wide minus the 30 px FOCUS_MED selector on both sides; FontSize24, spacing 1.
# Hero list: UiList 320 wide minus the 20 px FOCUS_SMALL selector on both sides.
# Dialog titles: UiArtText 590 wide, FontSize30, spacing 3.
# Hero stat labels: AlignRight in a 110 px box, FontSize12, spacing 1; wider text runs past the box.
# Yes/No list: UiList 180 wide minus the 30 px FOCUS_MED selector on both sides; FontSize30, spacing 1.
# Game selection list: UiList 285 wide minus 2 * 20 px.
# Difficulty and speed lists: UiList 295 wide minus 2 * 20 px.
# Title FormatRuntime(_("Join {:s} Games"), _("Client-Server (TCP)")): 590 - (290 - 49) for the Russian argument.
# Connection list: UiList 285 wide minus 2 * 20 px, FontSize12.
# Option names drawn as the settings title when their list submenu opens: 640 px, FontSize30, spacing 8.
# Key and pad action names drawn as the settings title in their binding submenu: 640 px, FontSize30, spacing 8.
# Quick spell 1..12 and quick message 1..10: 640 - (width("10") 35 - width("{}") 30).
# Option names on their own split "{}:" line in the 500 px settings list: 500 - 1 - width(":") 6; FontSize24, spacing 1.
